name: Morpho-PE
author: sd88me
summary: Four-voice synthesizer modelled on the Poly Evolver's voice: analog-style and digital waveshape oscillators, 2/4-pole lowpass, delay, feedback, distortion, 4 x 16 step sequencer, a bank browser and a touchscreen skin with Q-Links. Loads Poly Evolver program dumps and, from your own Prophet VS ROM chip images, the 95 factory waves.
